messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Vedi | Command to visually attend | ನೋಡು | “see / behold” | OK | | la | Definite article (feminine) | – (not expressed) | – | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | The creature that is the causal factor | ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು | “the beast” | OK | | per | Preposition introducing causal relation | ಅದರಿಂದ | “because of / from that” | OK | | cu' (cui) | Relative pronoun “which” (causal) | ಅದರಿಂದ | “because of which” | OK | | io | Speaker (subject) | ನಾನು | “I” | OK | | mi (reflexive) | Reflexive pronoun marking self‑directed action | – (implicit) | – | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | “turned” (past) | ತಿರುಗಿದ್ದೆ | “turned” | OK | | aiutami | Imperative “help me” | ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡು | “help (do)” | OK | | da | Preposition “against” | ವಿರುದ್ಧ | “against” | OK | | lei | Feminine pronoun “her” | ಅವಳ | “her” | OK | | famoso | Attribute “famous” | ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ | “famous” | OK | | saggio | Noun “sage” (vocative) | ಜ್ಞಾನಿ | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella (che ella) | Conjunction “for she” | ಅವಳು | “she” | OK | | mi (object) | Pronoun “me” (experiencer) | ನನ್ನ | “my / me” | OK | | fa | Causative verb “makes” | ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ | “makes / does” | OK | | tremar | Infinitive “to tremble” | ಕಂಪಿಸುವಂತೆ | “to tremble (as)” | OK | | le | Definite article (feminine plural) | – (not expressed) | – | UNNECESSARY | | vene | “veins” | ರಕ್ತನಾಳಗಳು | “veins” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | i | Definite article (masculine plural) | – (not expressed) | – | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | “pulses” | ನಾಡಿಗಳನ್ನು | “pulses” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `mi` (reflexive), `le`, `i` – Kannada does not use definite articles or a separate reflexive pronoun in this construction, so these elements are naturally omitted. - **No MISSING or WRONG entries** – every lexical meaning from the source is represented in the Kannada translation, either directly or by a language‑specific omission that is marked as UNNECESSARY.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: Vedi la bestia per cu' io mi volsi; - Issue: none - Corrected: ಆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡು, ಅದರಿಂದ ನಾನು ತಿರುಗಿದ್ದೆ;
- Line 89: - Original: aiutami da lei, famoso saggio, - Issue: none - Corrected: ಅವಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡು, ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಜ್ಞಾನಿ,
- Line 90: - Original: ch'ella mi fa tremar le vene e i polsi». - Issue: none - Corrected: ಅವಳು ನನ್ನ ರಕ್ತನಾಳಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಾಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಪಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ»
``` ಆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡು, ಅದರಿಂದ ನಾನು ತಿರುಗಿದ್ದೆ; ಅವಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡು, ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಜ್ಞಾನಿ, ಅವಳು ನನ್ನ ರಕ್ತನಾಳಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಾಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಪಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ» ```
